rows.evidence: Carried from round 1 (F3-SC1-b.round1, pin 95f3f8cb; cited lines and card ids byte-identical since that pin; the delta changes only L05.html:375, index.html:33 and card SC1-c238, none cited by this row): Carried from round 14 (L06.html byte-identical since the previous pin): Step 1 (pathwise identity W_s = 2B_{s wedge rho} - B_s for s<=t): case tau_a >= t (rho=t, both sides B_s) and case tau_a < t (s<=tau_a gives B_s; tau_a<s<=t gives 2a - B_s). Step 2 (splitting theta_j = s_j wedge rho, V_j = B_{theta_j}, U_j = B_{s_j} - B_{theta_j}): W_{s_j} = V_j - U_j and U_j = X_{(s_j - rho)^+}. Step 3: theta_j stopping time, V_j F_{theta_j}-measurable by A4(h), F_{theta_j} subset F_rho since theta_j <= rho (intersection argument written out). Step 4 (freezing): (W_{s_j})_j = V - Psi(rho,X), (B_{s_j})_j = V + Psi(rho,X); A4(b) gives conditional expectations G_-(V,rho) and G_+(V,rho); G_- = G_+ because Psi(r,-x) = -Psi(r,x) and -X has the same finite-dimensional law as X. Step 5: fdd equal for every finite set of times (each lies in some [0,t]); W continuous since 2a - a = a at tau_a. All five steps are correct.

Checked by ledgers/SC1/scripts/SC1-d-r1/dyadic_sketch_r1.py (output out/dyadic_sketch_r1.txt): for 1894 rationals t in [0,1] (q up to 60, plus 1/3, 2/7, 1e-6, 999999/1e6), t_k = ceil(2^k t)/2^k is dyadic, lies in [t,1], is non-increasing in k, and satisfies 0 <= t_k - t < 2^-39 at k = 39: 0 violations. t=1 gives the constant 1 and t=0 the constant 0; t=1/3 gives 1, 1/2, 1/2, 3/8, 3/8, 11/32.
